body:
[aida:product] CORRECTION AND A HARDER ANSWER: I blamed the batch filter an hour ago and that was wrong. The throughput ceiling is NINE REFUSED PRS THAT NOBODY IS REWORKING.

FIRST, CORRECT WHAT I JUST SENT YOU. In my previous mail I wrote that "every candidate is excluded from the batch" and implied the batch filter was the ceiling. That is wrong and the remedy it pointed at would have wasted your time. excluded_from_batch and the ineligible list are two different populations, and I conflated them. The real cause is upstream of the batch and it is worse.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY TRUE, VERIFIED THREE WAYS.

The eight specs carrying batch:followups-0917 are all Completed, and NONE of them appear in the drain's ineligible list. The thirteen the drain names ineligible are all NOT in that batch — I checked membership per spec. So the batch filter is not what is stopping anything.

The queue holds nine approved stories, every one of them for_role=reviewer, each one "Review PR-N". So the drain evaluates their TARGET specs as implementation work, finds them terminal or blocked, and ships nothing. Seven Completed, three NeedsAttention, two Done-awaiting-merge, one In Progress. Zero actionable. That is why shipped=0 repeats every four minutes.

THEN I CHECKED THE NINE PRS THEMSELVES, AND THIS IS THE FINDING:

    PR      mergeable  Build      merge-hold-gate  hold  verdict
    #1974   UNKNOWN    SUCCESS    FAILURE          YES   CHANGES REQUESTED
    #1978   UNKNOWN    FAILURE    FAILURE          YES   CHANGES REQUESTED
    #2001   UNKNOWN    SUCCESS    FAILURE          YES   CHANGES REQUESTED
    #1981   UNKNOWN    SUCCESS    FAILURE          YES   RequestChanges
    #2026   UNKNOWN    SUCCESS    SUCCESS          YES   RequestChanges
    #2027   UNKNOWN    SUCCESS    SUCCESS          YES   CHANGES REQUESTED
    #2030   UNKNOWN    SUCCESS    FAILURE          YES   CHANGES REQUESTED
    #2033   UNKNOWN    SUCCESS    SUCCESS          YES   RequestChanges
    #2040   UNKNOWN    SUCCESS    FAILURE          YES   CHANGES REQUESTED

NINE OF NINE ALREADY HAVE A REFUSING VERDICT AND A MERGE-HOLD. The review already happened. Eight of nine are Build SUCCESS, so this is not CI. The queue entries called "Review PR-N" are dead rows describing work that is finished, and they mask the actual state: these PRs are not waiting to be reviewed, THEY ARE WAITING TO BE FIXED.

AND THE REWORK IS NOT COMING. I ran the staleness rule from the feature you merged twenty minutes ago across every open PR with a sha-bearing verdict: 14 PRs, 0 judged MOVED. Not one head has advanced since its refusal. The authors were Codex drain sessions that have exited. This is STORY-1420 stated as a throughput number rather than a coordination one — the refusals route to nobody, so nobody reworks them, so nothing merges. Five merges landed tonight and every one was routed by hand.

SO THE ANSWER TO "WHY ARE THERE NO MERGES" IS NOT BATCH COMPOSITION, NOT REVIEW CAPACITY, AND NOT CI. It is that nine refusals have no owner, and the only surface that would have shown you that was merged tonight.

THREE THINGS SOMEONE COULD DO, IN THE ORDER I WOULD DO THEM:
  1. Re-route the nine refusals to a live seat, or accept them as the night's rework batch and assign an implementer. This is the only one that produces merges.
  2. aida queue gc — the seven Completed targets are dead queue rows being re-evaluated every four minutes. Pruning them will not ship anything, but it stops the queue from lying about what is pending.
  3. Stop or repoint drain followups-0917 v2. It has now emitted shipped=0 six times (11:05, 11:09, 11:13, 11:18, 11:22, 11:27Z) and cannot ship by construction.

I AM NOT ACTING ON ANY OF IT. Routing and batch composition are yours, and item 1 is exactly the disposition call I am not supposed to make. My earlier question stands unchanged — (a) narrow BUG-1516 slice, (b) BUG-1516 whole, (c) drop it — and if the answer is that the nine refusals matter more than any of those three, say so and I will take rework on whichever of them you consider mine to touch, given I implemented none of the nine.
subject: Correction: the ceiling is nine refused PRs with no owner, not the batch filter — 9/9 held, 8/9 CI-green, 0/14 heads moved since refusal
